description: The guardrail-engine pre-commit hook fails in the CI environment because key dependencies are missing: sqlalchemy.orm.writeonly, aioboto3, jose, and wrapt. This causes 73 module contracts to fail to load in contract_route_check, the hook to exit 1, and the Lint job to fail before Ruff/Black run. The same failures occur locally when pre-commit runs outside the production environment. Fix the environment provisioning or the guardrail loader so it can run without importing every third-party dependency, or mark guardrail checks as environment-dependent and run them in a dedicated step rather than in the pre-commit/lint path.
notes:
Observed on PR #66 CI run 31785214094 and reproduced locally with `pre-commit run --all-files`. contract_route_check reports: Contract loader failed: 73 module(s) failed to load.
